description: Define a custom item and its event workflow branches.
examples: Set the item fields and connect each event branch to its workflow.

inputs.name: content_id
inputs.description: Sets the stable ID for this custom item.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Sets the display name stored with the item.

inputs.name: material
inputs.description: Selects the vanilla material used by the item.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.description: Chooses the content provider.

inputs.name: external_id
inputs.description: Selects the provider asset when the provider supplies one.

inputs.name: custom_model_data
inputs.description: Sets the custom model data value.

inputs.name: components
inputs.description: Provides the item component values.

inputs.name: lore
inputs.description: Provides comma- or line-separated lore text.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Provides comma- or line-separated item tags.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Controls whether this content definition can run.

inputs.name: priority
inputs.description: Sets the order used when matching content events.

inputs.name: cooldown_scope
inputs.description: Chooses which owner shares the event cooldown.

inputs.name: cooldown_ticks
inputs.description: Sets the cooldown duration in server ticks.

inputs.name: permission
inputs.description: Requires this permission before handling an event.

inputs.name: cancel_event
inputs.description: Cancels the source event when the rule runs.

inputs.name: consume_event
inputs.description: Consumes the source event when the rule runs.

inputs.name: require_sneaking
inputs.description: Runs only while the player is sneaking.

inputs.name: require_on_ground
inputs.description: Runs only while the player is on the ground.

inputs.name: hand_filter
inputs.description: Limits matching to a hand for hand-based events.

inputs.name: target_filter
inputs.description: Limits matching to the selected target group.

inputs.name: allowed_worlds
inputs.description: Lists worlds where this content may run.

inputs.name: denied_worlds
inputs.description: Lists worlds where this content must not run.

inputs.name: chance_percent
inputs.description: Sets the percentage chance that a matching event runs.

inputs.name: max_activations_per_tick
inputs.description: Limits activations per server tick; zero means no configured limit.

outputs.name: use
outputs.description: Runs when the item is used.

outputs.name: left_click
outputs.description: Runs when the item is left-clicked.

outputs.name: right_click
outputs.description: Runs when the item is right-clicked.

outputs.name: hit_entity
outputs.description: Runs when the item hits an entity.

outputs.name: damage_entity
outputs.description: Runs when the item damages an entity.

outputs.name: break_block
outputs.description: Runs when the item breaks a block.

outputs.name: consume
outputs.description: Runs when the item is consumed.

outputs.name: drop
outputs.description: Runs when the item is dropped.

outputs.name: pickup
outputs.description: Runs when the item is picked up.

outputs.name: while_holding
outputs.description: Runs while the item is held.

outputs.name: player
outputs.description: Returns the player involved in the event.

outputs.name: content_id
outputs.description: Returns the matched content ID.

outputs.name: content_type
outputs.description: Returns the matched content type.

outputs.name: trigger
outputs.description: Returns the event trigger name.

outputs.name: item
outputs.description: Returns the item involved in the event.

outputs.name: block
outputs.description: Returns the block involved in the event.

outputs.name: target
outputs.description: Returns the target entity involved in the event.

outputs.name: location
outputs.description: Returns the event location.

outputs.name: damage
outputs.description: Returns damage associated with the event.

description: Give a custom content item to a player.
examples: Connect Flow, choose a player and content ID, and set the amount to give.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the content grant.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Selects the player who receives the content.

inputs.name: content_id
inputs.description: Selects the custom content to give.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: Sets how many items to give.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the content grant is attempted.

outputs.name: item
outputs.description: Returns the item that was created when the grant succeeded.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the content was created and given.

description: Read the active cooldown and progress for a custom-content event.
examples: Connect Flow, choose the content event, and branch on Ready or Cooldown.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the cooldown query.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Selects the player whose cooldown is read.

inputs.name: content_id
inputs.description: Selects the custom content whose cooldown is read.

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: Identifies the custom-content event to inspect.

inputs.name: instance_id
inputs.description: Provides the item instance ID when the event uses instance scope.

outputs.name: ready
outputs.description: Continues when the content event is ready.

outputs.name: cooldown
outputs.description: Continues while the content event is on cooldown.

outputs.name: supported
outputs.description: Reports whether cooldown tracking is supported for the selected event.

outputs.name: is_ready
outputs.description: Reports whether the event can run now.

outputs.name: remaining_ticks
outputs.description: Returns the remaining cooldown in server ticks.

outputs.name: remaining_seconds
outputs.description: Returns the remaining cooldown in seconds.

outputs.name: elapsed_ticks
outputs.description: Returns the elapsed cooldown time in ticks.

outputs.name: cooldown_ticks
outputs.description: Returns the configured cooldown duration in ticks.

outputs.name: progress
outputs.description: Returns normalized cooldown progress from zero to one.

outputs.name: progress_percent
outputs.description: Returns cooldown progress as a percentage.

outputs.name: current_tick
outputs.description: Returns the current server tick used for the cooldown.

outputs.name: ready_tick
outputs.description: Returns the server tick when the event becomes ready.

outputs.name: scope
outputs.description: Returns the cooldown owner scope.

outputs.name: key
outputs.description: Returns the resolved cooldown key.

outputs.name: trigger
outputs.description: Returns the resolved custom-content trigger.
